intent: Converge the warranted runtime-control fixes from the deployed recovery snapshot onto current main, add a versioned release runner, and make every current orchestrate-live command boundary fail closed on explicit provenance. A tracked checkout must be clean and either exactly current origin/main or an explicitly pinned current-main descendant; a separately governed source-only image can instead present and re-verify an image-baked source manifest, which is typed as container-image provenance rather than canonical Git authority. Harden the release boundary against blank pins, ignored import bytecode, interpreter traversal, and symlinked virtual environments. Preserve the already-landed stronger quarantine-status implementation from PR 1110 rather than replaying its older release commit.

commit.message: fix(runtime): converge release controls and fail closed on stale launch

interface_mismatches: The deployed release carries two runtime-control commits that are absent from current main, while current main already carries a stronger version of the release's quarantine-status commit.
The machine launchd runner is unversioned and selects release code while borrowing the stale checkout's interpreter and secret file, so its provenance and dependency boundary are split.
The current CLI starts orchestrate-live from any checkout that imports it, including clean branches that are hundreds of commits behind origin/main.
The separately owned source-only image has no Git metadata, so it needs a distinct manifest-bound provenance value rather than being mislabeled as canonical Git authority.
closest_existing_implementation: main commit fdf9670f0 implementing PR 1110 quarantine-status compatibility
honest_blockers: A source-level guard cannot retroactively alter old checkouts; the versioned release runner must be installed at the stable machine path and launchd must be repointed during the separately controlled live cutover.
The admission comparison uses the shared local origin/main ref; deployment must fetch immediately before cutting and pinning the release.

Container-image admission proves equality to an image-baked source manifest, not equality to canonical Git; the Docker build and runner changes remain in the separately owned organism-rewire lane and must land before this PR.
This lane does not stop, restart, mutate, or claim health for the live daemon.
Exact-head hosted CI, independent review policy, and operator merge and deployment authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Restore the prior stable machine runner and release root, then revert the runtime admission module, command-boundary calls, release-runner script, runtime-control gates, tests, and this packet together. Do not roll back PR 1110 or rewrite quarantined task rows.
